summary: Backend + frontend regression for the image-upload bug-fix (Emergent Object Storage) and the new Ready-SMS background feature. Backend: 13/13 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_upload_and_sms.py pass — POST /api/admin/upload accepts PNG/JPG/WEBP even when sent as application/octet-stream (magic-byte detection working), returns {image_url:'/api/files/<uuid>.<ext>'}; GET /api/files/<name> serves bytes with correct Content-Type and exact byte length; rejects fake image with 400, rejects >5MB with 400, unauthenticated 401, unknown file 404. Product create/update swap image_url correctly; old file still serves (no deletion). Seed 'Dark chocolate brownie' is migrated to /api/files/... and serves. PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status=ready returns 200 in <5s; within ~1s ready_sms_status='failed' and ready_sms_detail='SMS not configured' land on the order; subsequent 'ready' PATCH keeps fields; moving to 'completed' works. GET /api/admin/settings -> {sms_configured:false}. Orders regression (POST/GET/admin list) still green. Note: preview ingress (Cloudflare) overwrites Cache-Control from 'public, immutable' to 'no-store' — backend header is correct but end-user won't get CDN caching. Frontend (desktop 1920x1080): Add-product with PNG shows 'Uploading…' -> 'Replace image', product-image-preview naturalWidth=400 with src=/api/files/*.png; save renders product row img with naturalWidth>0 and src '/api/files/'; reload persists. Edit -> preview shows existing image, replace with JPG then WEBP each updates preview src and persists on row after reload. Non-image .txt triggers product-upload-error 'Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.' and NO POST /api/admin/upload request is made. product-image-remove clears the preview. Public / renders new product card + 'Dark chocolate brownie' with naturalWidth>0 and src '/api/files/'. Admin Orders: opening a new order shows sms-status 'Ready-SMS is off: add Twilio credentials…'; clicking status-btn-ready flips to Ready and within ~5-10s sms-status becomes 'SMS could not be sent — SMS not configured' (poll works). Customer /order/ST-1016 tracking page shows Ready step as current.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py serve_file sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' but Cloudflare/preview ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — verified via response headers. Not a functional bug (images decode correctly) but immutable caching is lost in preview; may or may not be a problem in prod ingress. Consider a X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header while you're there.
storage.py init_storage stores the key in a module global (_storage_key) with a naive force-refresh on 404. Fine for single-worker uvicorn; will re-init per worker under multi-process — acceptable.
notify_ready background task never times out — a hanging Twilio HTTP call will pin an event loop thread indefinitely. Consider asyncio.wait_for around asyncio.to_thread(_send, ...) with a 15-20s cap.

update_order_status guard `order['status'] != 'ready'` prevents SMS re-send only when currently non-ready — if a manual status flip from ready->preparing->ready happens and the first attempt failed (no ready_sms_sent_at), a second SMS will be attempted, which is the intended behavior but the code comment/UX doesn't state it.
server.py mounts /uploads and /api/uploads StaticFiles even after migration to object storage — dead code once all legacy urls are migrated; can be removed for defense-in-depth.
App.js remains a single minified line — extremely hard to review/diff (previously flagged). Extract ProductRow/ProductModal/Dashboard.
detect_image only inspects the first bytes and won't detect animated WebP variants that start with different chunk ordering; PIL round-trip WebPs are fine (verified).
seed_data_creation: Created & CLEANED UP TEST_UPL2_* product via API + UI. Orders created via API (still present, prefixed TEST_SmsFront/TEST_Regress/TEST_ReadySms; counter now ~ST-1016 — mongo cleanup left to main agent). Seed products Dark chocolate brownie, Chocolate Thickshake, French Fries, Cheese Nachos unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_upload_and_sms.py (+ prior test_ordering.py, test_categories_reorder.py, test_story_cafe_api.py). Run all: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/all.xml`. Notes: (1) Preview Cloudflare strips 'immutable' Cache-Control on /api/files responses — do not assert cache header. (2) Image preview img in ProductModal takes ~300ms to actually decode after upload finishes; poll naturalWidth>0 rather than asserting immediately. (3) Product rows live in `.item-cell` divs (not <tr>). Use `.item-cell` closest `.table-row` for finding row elements. (4) Ready-SMS status update takes up to 5-6s to reflect in UI due to 5s polling; the backend field is set within ~500ms. (5) PIL-generated WebP is 400x300 solid color and passes magic-byte detect. (6) Twilio env vars intentionally empty — sms_configured() returns False; do NOT populate.
rca of the issue: Original bug ('image never rendered on admin/menu after upload') RCA validated: (a) old flow stored files under /uploads which the k8s ingress does not route to backend (only /api/* is proxied), so received the SPA HTML shell -> browser shows alt text. Fixed by moving to Emergent Object Storage with a /api/files/{name} route that streams bytes with correct Content-Type. (b) WebP was rejected when the client's MIME was not exactly image/webp — fixed by magic-byte sniffing via detect_image() ignoring the client-supplied Content-Type. Both are verified in tests: octet-stream Content-Type still succeeds; /api/files/... serves image bytes correctly; legacy /uploads/ product URLs auto-migrated at startup (Dark chocolate brownie now on /api/files/).
